name: crt0_Init
notes: Nintendo SDK crt0: set IRQ/SYS stacks, install IntrMain, call AgbMain

name: IntrMain
notes: SDK interrupt dispatcher; copied to IWRAM 0x03003A60; table at 0x03003A10

name: Text_FindChar
notes: strchr variant used by script parsing

name: Menu_EraseRect
notes: (x, y, w, h) clear UI text area; must be called before overdrawing text

name: Menu_DrawText
notes: (x, y, char *text) draw text in the UI

name: Time_ShowRegionMenu
notes: region select screen; page number at menu+0x1C

name: Video_GetBackgroundMap
notes: (int bg) -> EWRAM buffer holding that BG's tilemap

name: Script_SetPc
notes: event bytecode interpreter: set PC, returns PC

name: Script_SeekToKeyword
notes: advance PC to next keyword instruction (char kw)

name: Script_ParseStringRef
notes: u16 string id operand of the current string-ref instruction
